description: Sturgian blue floor-length wool court overdress over a cream embroidered linen shift, with low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice, elbow sleeves and red-cream geometric woven borders at straps, neckline, cuffs, front and hem. Round metal clasps fasten straps and a rich patterned sash belt with fringed hanging ends. A pale wool wrap with blue borders and fringed ends rests on the arms; dark leather ankle boots complete the outfit.
